title: Charred Chicken Wings Tagine
description: A North African-inspired dish with charred chicken wings cooked in a flavorful tagine sauce. Serve with crusty bread or couscous for a hearty meal.
instructions: Rinse the chicken wings and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tagine sauce, zesty lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Brush the chicken wings with the russian olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, warm the tagine sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the chicken is done, toss with the warmed tagine sauce and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
